newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Gulf oil revenues are expected to rise to $90 billion in 1996 from $78 billion last year, leading to a fall in the budget deficits of each state, according to a study by the Emirates Industrial Bank.
- Abu Dhabi on Saturday set up a new body -- the Higher Consultative Committee for the Development of the Abu Dhabi Emirate -- to attract investment and diversify the economy.
- The Ajman Free Zone has embarked on a major expansion programme aimed at upgrading its facilities and boosting its capacity to accomodate over 600 companies in the next four years.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan met visiting Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat and they discussed recent developments in the Palestinian-Israeli arena.
- Since its creation in 1971, the Abu Dhabi Development Fund has supplied 12.7 billion dirhams in loans and grants.
